improve(errors): replace bare assert with proper exceptions in 4 modules

Replace 7 bare assert statements with proper exception handling:
- dowhy/causal_prediction/dataloaders/misc.py (1 assert -> ValueError)
- dowhy/gcm/falsify.py (1 assert -> TypeError)
- dowhy/causal_refuters/overrule/utils.py (2 asserts -> ValueError, TypeError)
- dowhy/causal_refuters/overrule/BCS/overlap_boolean_rule.py (3 asserts -> ValueError)

This improves error reporting and aligns with #1816 effort to eliminate bare asserts.
